gaps: OS_API_BASE_CREDENTIAL_SCOPE_GAP
--api-base is arbitrary while OS_DATA_HUB_API_KEY and OS_DATA_HUB_BEARER_TOKEN are appended to requests, allowing ambient credentials to be sent to an unapproved origin.
Pin the exact OS Downloads HTTPS origin and never forward credentials to custom or redirected hosts.
OS_API_SESSION_TRUST_ENV_GAP
The resolver creates requests.Session without disabling trust_env, so proxy and netrc state can alter product and download traffic.
Set trust_env=False, clear proxy/auth state and receipt the effective transport policy.
OS_PRODUCT_RELEASE_LICENSE_IDENTITY_GAP
Product selection is based on a name/title regex and id presence only; release date, annual July version, OpenData status and licence identity are not bound.
Require the exact product metadata contract and record release/version/licence fields before download selection.
OS_DOWNLOAD_URL_HTTPS_HOST_BINDING_GAP
A selected item URL is accepted when it merely starts with http, and the same OS headers/parameters are sent to it.
Require HTTPS plus an approved OS/download host and exact product/file identity before any request.
OS_DOWNLOAD_REDIRECT_FINAL_IDENTITY_GAP
Archive downloads follow redirects but do not validate final scheme, host, path or redirect count.
Use bounded redirects and revalidate the final HTTPS object identity after every hop.
OS_DOWNLOAD_RESPONSE_PROVENANCE_GAP
The archive receipt records resolved URL and content type but does not require Content-Length consistency or record status, final host, ETag and Last-Modified.
Validate and receipt the full HTTP representation identity before accepting the archive.
OS_DOWNLOAD_PARTIAL_FILE_ATOMICITY_GAP
Download bytes are written directly to the final ZIP path, leaving a partial or stale file if streaming or validation fails.
Stream to a unique same-volume temporary file, flush, validate and atomically replace the target.
OS_ARCHIVE_AREA_TILE_CONTENT_BINDING_GAP
Archive acceptance requires only some ASC/TXT member somewhere in the outer or nested ZIP and does not prove the required area or 10 km tile set.
Bind archive members to the requested area and exact required tile identifiers before readiness.
OS_ARCHIVE_MEMBER_COUNT_NAME_POLICY_GAP
ZIP validation has no member-count, path-length, reserved-name, ADS or case-fold collision policy.
Apply bounded member/path limits and a Windows-safe unique normalized name set before extraction or inspection.
OS_ARCHIVE_ENCRYPTION_COMPRESSION_METHOD_GAP
Encrypted members and unsupported or unusually expensive compression methods are not rejected explicitly.
Reject encrypted members and allow only a pinned compression-method set.
OS_ARCHIVE_COMPRESSION_RATIO_GAP
Member file_size is bounded but compress_size and expansion ratio are not checked.
Enforce per-member and aggregate expansion-ratio ceilings using ZipInfo metadata.
OS_NESTED_ARCHIVE_AGGREGATE_BUDGET_GAP
Each nested ZIP is limited individually, but many nested archives can consume unbounded aggregate compressed and decompressed work during recursive inspection.
Track a generation-wide nested archive count and compressed/uncompressed byte budget.
OS_ARCHIVE_DIRECT_MEMBER_CRC_GAP
Direct ASC/TXT members can satisfy archive readiness without being read or CRC-tested.
Read and verify required members or run an equivalent bounded integrity test before readiness.
TERRAIN50_ASCII_EXTENSION_CONTENT_GAP
Any .asc or .txt member can satisfy the ASCII-grid existence check without validating the six-line AAIGrid header or numeric body.
Parse a strict Terrain50 AAIGrid schema before treating the member as grid data.
TERRAIN50_WRAPPER_SUBPROCESS_TIMEOUT_TREE_GAP
The wrapper subprocess helper has no timeout for resolver or crosschecker and no descendant process-tree cleanup.
Apply bounded stage timeouts, terminate the full process tree and publish timeout receipts.
TERRAIN50_RESOLVER_MANIFEST_GENERATION_HASH_GAP
The wrapper trusts resolver archive paths after exit code zero without binding task, attempt, continuation, generation or rehashing every archive against the resolver receipt.
Require a strict generation manifest and verify every child path, size and SHA immediately before extraction.
TERRAIN50_ROOT_RECURSION_RESOURCE_BOUND_GAP
Configured-root discovery recursively walks all files without file-count, path-length, aggregate-byte or elapsed-time ceilings.
Bound traversal resources before opening candidate grids.
TERRAIN50_ROOT_FINAL_PATH_CONTAINMENT_GAP
Configured-root discovery accepts file symlinks or reparse targets without proving the final file remains under the approved root.
Open files under the authorized root and verify final-handle containment and volume identity.
TERRAIN50_DIRECTORY_SOURCE_AGGREGATE_IDENTITY_GAP
Directory sources publish source_archive_sha256 as null and have no aggregate manifest binding the exact file set and metadata.
Hash a sorted directory manifest containing relative path, size, SHA, tile and sidecar identity.
TERRAIN50_SAMPLE_HASH_TOCTOU_GAP
A raster is sampled and then hashed by reopening its path, so the recorded digest may not represent the bytes that produced the values.
Hash and sample the same immutable file handle or verify stable file identity before and after both operations.
TERRAIN50_EXPECTED_PIXEL_COUNT_CONTRACT_GAP
The crosschecker accepts any positive all-touched value count and does not require the pinned per-row cell identities or expected total of seven cells.
Bind the exact selected cell centres and expected counts for all three polygons.
TERRAIN50_PRJ_ASC_PAIR_IDENTITY_GAP
PRJ sidecars are copied but each ASC is not required to have one exact same-basename sidecar with a recorded hash and expected BNG definition.
Require a unique ASC/PRJ pair and bind both hashes and CRS text to the tile.
TERRAIN50_SCREENING_RECOMPUTE_PRECISION_GAP
Accuracy screening trusts a rounded absolute_crosscheck_difference_m field instead of recomputing the finite non-negative delta from unrounded Terrain50 and EA medians.
Recompute from source values at full precision, require finite non-negative inputs and round only for display.
TERRAIN50_REVIEW_TIER_AUTO_PASS_GAP
Rows between 4.15 m and 8.30 m are labelled review-required but the wrapper still returns success and THREE_OS_TERRAIN50_CROSSCHECKS_READY.
Block automatic readiness until a generation-bound human-review receipt exists for every review-tier row.
